text: Đà Nẵng to begin key maritime and industrial urban projects

ĐÀ NẴNG - Đà Nẵng has approved an investment project to develop the Cửa Lở Estuary as a major maritime lane for accessibility of cargo ships with capacity up to 50,000 dead weight tonnage (DWT) to Tam Hiệp Port in the Chu Lai Open Economic Zone (OEZ).
The Chu Lai OEZ management board said the maritime infrastructure will be developed by Đại Quang Minh Property JSC with an investment of VNĐ7.58 trillion (US$295 million).
According to the board, the project will help build sea dike systems, dredge the 6.6km lane for easy cargo ship access and expand the Tam Hiệp Port's capacity to nine million tonnes of cargo in 2030.
Scheduled for construction in the fourth quarter this year, the project will be put into operation by the end of 2028, the board said.

Đà Nẵng municipal authorities also previously approved investment proposals for three key industrial urban projects worth $1.2 billion, part of booming investment in industrial and high-tech parks in the near future.

A series of key investment projects in the Chu Lai OEZ were started in the third quarter of 2026, including Tam Anh Industrial Zone 1 with a total investment of VNĐ1.5 trillion ($58 million), three industrial infrastructure projects at Nam Thăng Bình Industrial Park worth VNĐ1 trillion ($39 million) and the $158 million Tam Anh-An An Hòa Industrial Park.
The city also plans to upgrade Chu Lai International Airport with an investment of $10 billion to meet growing demand driven by tourism, investment and logistics through 2050.
Thaco Group already operates its own 50,000DTW berth in the Chu Lai Port as a key logistics service for the East-West Economic Corridor linking Thailand, Myanmar, Laos and Việt Nam.

The Chu Lai OEZ management board reported that it has drawn 265 domestic and FDI projects with total capital of $959 million in the first 10 months of 2026, with the zone aiming for $5 billion in investment by 2030. - VNS
